Word7000 Support

Need help with Word7000? This page is the public support entry for the web and iOS versions.

Common checks

  • If sign-in does not return to the app, confirm that the Supabase redirect URL includes word7000://auth/callback.
  • If progress does not sync, sign out and sign in again with the same Google or Apple account.
  • If a web app update does not appear, use the update prompt or refresh the page.

Account data

Signed-in users can delete synced Word7000 learning data from the app settings screen.

Contact

For now, contact the app owner through the GitHub project or the support channel listed in App Store Connect.
